name: mathExpressionCalculator
description: Evaluates a mathematical expression given as a string in JavaScript format.
longDescription: This tool takes a mathematical expression as a string and evaluates it. The expression can include functions like cos, sin, exp, etc., directly without using the Math object.

expression.description: A mathematical expression in JavaScript format (e.g., 'cos(23) + exp(3)').

code: (({expression}) => { window.cos = Math.cos; window.sin = Math.sin; window.exp = Math.exp; window.sqrt = Math.sqrt; return eval(expression);})()
